How to verify: Match the drawing, cut list, estimate, and field notes to one named revision and date.
Pass criteria: Every person and downstream file points to the same released revision.

How to verify: Mark each dimension as field measured, manufacturer supplied, design derived, or still provisional.
Pass criteria: No critical dimension is treated as measured when it is only assumed.

How to verify: State the working unit, rounding rule, and measuring-tool resolution beside the project inputs.
Pass criteria: Conversions and rounded values cannot silently change a finished size.

How to verify: Write who approved the current inputs and which layouts, quantities, labels, or orders must be regenerated after a change.
Pass criteria: The decision trail is complete enough to reproduce the release.

How to verify: Use the current manufacturer drawing and the physical product when available, including projections and connectors.
Pass criteria: The opening exceeds the required operating and installation envelope.

How to verify: Trace door swing, drawer travel, pull clearance, shelf removal, and nearby traffic through the full motion.
Pass criteria: Nothing collides at full travel or during removal.

How to verify: Locate water, power, ventilation, fasteners, filters, and future replacement paths.
Pass criteria: Required service points remain reachable after installation.
